title: 日本語の森 N4 — 敬語の基本 (Introduction to Keigo)
description: From 日本語の森. This N4 lesson introduces Japanese honorific language (敬語): the difference between 丁寧語, 尊敬語, and 謙譲語. Shows how verbs change form in formal contexts (言う→おっしゃる, 食べる→召し上がる, もらう→いただく) using workplace and daily-life examples.
